common_requirements: Device acquisition timestamps, units, calibration and sensor-to-boot mounting transform.
Explicit event-definition and method versions; packet-loss, clipping and clock-quality flags.
Task, terrain and available speed context; unknown context stays unknown.
No performance thresholds, composite score or technique diagnosis is authorised by this registry.

metrics.definition: Gyroscope angular velocity about boot-frame +X, after sensor-to-boot rotation and supported bias correction. Retain the time series, side and quality mask.
metrics.validation: Bench-check scale, sign and mounting; evaluate dynamic recordings against an independent motion reference.

metrics.definition: Difference between consecutive accepted alternating boundary timestamps under one versioned turn-boundary definition. This is one turn interval; same-side boundaries span a two-turn cycle and must have a different label.
unavailable_when: A boundary is missing or ambiguous
Clock discontinuity or invalid data spans the interval
not_equivalent_to: Time between arbitrary gyro zero crossings
metrics.validation: Compare missed/extra events and timestamp errors with independent same-definition annotations, separately by task and single/dual sensor configuration.

metrics.definition: Right-boot event timestamp minus left-boot event timestamp for a uniquely matched transition, using the same operational event definition and session clock. Preserve signed lag and clock/event uncertainty.
unavailable_when: Synchronisation uncertainty prevents meaningful lag interpretation
metrics.validation: Validate clocks and bilateral event matching independently. Do not tune a coaching threshold from these public videos.

metrics.definition: Within an accepted turn interval, (time of maximum absolute boot +X angular rate minus interval start) divided by interval duration. Specify filtering, tie handling and peak uncertainty in the method version. Retain peak sign separately.
not_equivalent_to: Phase of maximum ski edge angle
metrics.validation: Compare repeatability and independent task/outcome labels. Assessment level and turn task may require different interpretations.

metrics.definition: Sample standard deviation of accepted individual-turn durations divided by their mean, within a declared constant-rhythm task window. Retain durations, sample count, exclusion reasons and mean; fewer than two accepted durations is undefined.
unavailable_when: Intended task changes rhythm or turn shape
Detection failures make the selected sample misleading
metrics.validation: Establish detection reliability first, then test within matched tasks. Funnel drills and terrain-driven variation are separate contexts.
